title: Jalsa
desc: Sanjay, a former Naxalite, wishes to marry Indu, but her father rejects their alliance. After the couple parts ways, Sanjay falls for Bhagyamathi, unaware that she is Indu's sister.

title: S/O Satyamurthy
desc: Anand faces several challenges as he attempts to save his father's wealth while trying to handle the responsibility of earning a livelihood for his family.

title: Julayi
desc: When Ravi unknowingly thwarts Bittu's bank heist, he becomes the target of Bittu's wrath. Subsequently, Ravi is forced to fight to protect his loved ones from the ruthless criminal.

title: Attarintiki Daredi
desc: Goutham resolves to reunite his grandfather with Sunanda, his estranged aunt. However, he chooses to pose as a driver to befriend her.

title: Shubham
desc: Married men unite when their wives obsess over a cable soap opera, planning activities to cope, reflect, and reclaim family time while navigating friendship and temptation.

title: Bujjigaadu: Made in Chennai
desc: Bujji moves to Chennai for 12 years to stay away from his best friend Chitti, with the promise that she will marry him. When they finally reunite, Bujji is a thug with a mission on his hands.

title: Bedurulanka 2012
desc: As the 2012 apocalypse hysteria grips Bedurulanka, Bhushanam, Brahmam and Daniel deceive the villagers for personal gain. Shiva, sensing foul play, stands against their scheme.

title: Fun Time
desc: The programme includes comedy clips from Tollywood movies.

title: Uyyala Jampala
desc: When Suri learns that his cousin Uma is seeing someone, he decides to investigate and learns that the guy is a fraud. When Uma elopes with the boy, Suri tracks her down and tries to expose her lover.

title: Prati Roju Pandage
desc: A grandson chooses to help his elderly grandfather make the most of his remaining golden years as a way of celebrating life and strengthening their relationship.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, both of whom once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces against despotic rulers.

title: Krack
desc: Fiery officer Potharaju Shankar faces off against three dangerous outlaws. Meanwhile, their fierce feud quickly leads to unexpected consequences for everyone involved.

title: Pokiri
desc: Krishna, a police officer, disguises himself as a thug and joins the mafia in order to wipe out the underworld. Meanwhile, he falls in love with Shruti, an aerobics teacher.

title: DJ Tillu
desc: Bala Gangadhar Tilak, also known as DJ Tillu, is a young man who wishes to become a disc jockey someday. However, his life changes after he falls in love with Radhika.
